propositions: One-time force-push rewrite of tickets branch must execute after all prior dependencies close and writer quiescence is confirmed, with old tip non-resurrection verified

All workflows, timers, and agents must be disabled and paused before rewrite; trackers must converge; strip must execute in unfiltered clone; push must use --force-with-lease; old tip ancestry must be false post-push

Pre-publication assertions must verify descendant reconcile-bridge run ancestry, deployed review-bot epoch-mismatch refusal, and refreshed host runtime epoch-mismatch refusal; post-publication first write must record change/patchset/timestamp with old ancestry false and size-pack growth < 1 MB

Acceptance criteria span pre-push state snapshot (tree SHA, commit/merge counts, identity normalized hash), post-push non-resurrection (ancestry false, no default-clone refs to old tip), landed identity.enforce_since re-pin value, and post-enable reconciliation dry/live/canary success with zero drift
Quiescence gates require operator attestation of zero active sessions, all rebar-mcp servers stopped, and explicit confirmation before tracker reset and publication
All direct runtime proofs, ancestry checks, fsck clean result, and re-enable reconciliation success must be recorded before quiet window closes
